patterns.note: Wide content area with generous horizontal padding, often using a two-column split for text and supporting visuals (code, diagrams, partner logos).
Alternating light background sections (white and very light grey) are used to visually separate distinct content blocks on the page.
A sticky header navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, ensuring constant access to navigation links.
Prominent hero sections feature a large headline, descriptive text, and a code snippet or technical diagram, immediately establishing the product's technical nature.

technique_notes: The header navigation is built to stick to the top of the viewport, maintaining access to key links as the user scrolls.
Content sections are visually differentiated by alternating background colors between pure white and a very subtle light grey, providing clear visual breaks without harsh transitions.
Key features and explanations are presented in a two-column layout, pairing concise text descriptions with relevant code examples, technical diagrams, or partner logos to illustrate concepts.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, supported by readable body text and smaller, functional labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle for interactive elements like buttons, otherwise sharp for most content blocks and images.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between main sections and comfortable line spacing for readability.

standout: The site effectively uses code snippets and technical diagrams as primary visual elements within the hero and feature sections, immediately communicating a highly technical product for a developer audience. The 'Battle-hardened at Netflix' section, prominently featuring a well-known tech company, serves as a powerful social proof and case study.
